title: Pan-Seared Cod with Miso Glaze
description: A Japanese-inspired dish featuring pan-seared cod topped with a sweet and savory miso glaze. This hearty recipe is perfect for a special occasion or a romantic dinner.

ingredients.name: green onions
ingredients.notes: Thinly sliced green onions, for garnish

instructions: Season the cod fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat the sesame oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the cod fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, whisk together the miso paste, honey, soy sauce, and rice vinegar in a small bowl.
Brush the miso glaze over the cooked cod fillets.
Garnish with green onions and toasted sesame seeds.
